title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - TextileBasedWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/TextileBasedWearable. A wearable directly integrated into a textile artifact (e.g. a smart shirt). Subclass of OnBodyWearable per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The source ontology declares no additional own data/object property for this subclass beyond the classification itself: all properties (isLocatedOn and everything inherited from WearableDevice) are documented on the OnBodyWearable and WearableDevice models and not repeated here. Parent of FabricWearable.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TextileBasedWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
